_readme: Hand this file to your dev/agent together with the GLB files. It is the whole placement contract — you do NOT need the viewer HTML/CSS pages, those are only for inspecting models in the browser. Units: metres, y-up. Every GLB has its base at y=0 and is centred in x/z unless 'pivot' says otherwise. Shop front faces +z.

world.note: floor_interior is 0.06 m thick, so every fixture standing on the floor gets y = 0.06.

envelope.note: holes are cut to the exact models that fill them — do not re-scale either model
fills the 1.34 x 2.42 door hole; door_stop at local z = -0.06

envelope.pivot: ceiling underside — y is the visible ceiling face, NOT the base

envelope.note: STANDS ON THE FLOOR (it has its own 0.35 m plinth) — y = floor 0.06, not a sill height. Fills the 1.68 x 2.10 window hole with a 40 mm reveal each side.

envelope.pivot: HINGE AXIS at local x = 0, leaf extends +x — the group origin is NOT the door centre
envelope.note: = doorway_frame x - 0.50, y + 0.03 (threshold tread top). Animate rotationY 0 -> -1.6 rad to swing inward.

fixtures.note: against the back wall (wall_set inner face z = -5.5, half depth 0.23); add 0.06 (floor) to shelf_tops for world y
mounted on the RIGHT wall of wall_set: x = 4.75 - 0.15 (half depth), rotated -90 deg to face the room. World deck heights = 1.11 + deck_tops_local = 1.20 / 1.55 / 1.90
No image slots. Stand the special/hero bottle model on the top cap: world y = 0.06 + 1.025 = 1.085.

Rotated -90 deg: the counter's local +x runs along world +z (length 2.2 m, z = -0.15..2.15) and local +z faces the room at world -x, so the customer side is x = 3.25 and the staff side x = 3.95. Worktop world y = 0.06 + 1.105 = 1.165. Gold lip is a 22 mm perimeter frame only (top 1.125 local).

on_top.note: long axis along the counter; stack a second one at y = 1.365 with rotationY -1.5708

placement_rule: world_y_of_an_item = fixture.position[1] + surface_top_local. Bottles/glasses have their base at y = 0, so that value is the item's y directly.

wall_mounting.why: Every fixture is centred in x/z, so putting its origin ON the wall face buries half of it in the wall. Offset the origin by half the fixture's depth.
wall_mounting.rule: flush_origin = wall_inner_face +/- (fixture_depth / 2), then rotate to face the room.

worked_examples_room_shell.note: backing runs local z = 0 -> 0.02, so its origin sits ON the wall face

texture_slots.how: Every texturable panel is a named mesh using the shared 'slot_face' material. After loading: obj.getObjectByName('cabinet_header_slot').material = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ map: tex, roughness: 0.85 }); — replace the material, don't reuse slot_face (it is shared across all objects).
